prompts.capability: State a reservation time when arriving
prompts.cue: Say this to the host when you arrive.
prompts.english: We have a reservation at seven.
prompts.spanish: Tenemos una reserva a las siete.

target: Our reservation is for seven.
La reserva es para las siete.

prompts.capability: Sequence a polite drink request
prompts.cue: Ask the server for water before placing the rest of your order.
prompts.english: First, could you bring us water, please?
prompts.spanish: Primero, ¿podría traernos agua, por favor?

target: First, would you bring us some water, please?
Primero, ¿nos podría traer agua, por favor?

prompts.capability: Politely request an omission and give a reason
prompts.cue: Tell the server not to add onions to your salad.
prompts.english: Please don't add onions to my salad because I have an onion allergy.
prompts.spanish: Por favor, no agregue cebolla a mi ensalada porque tengo alergia a la cebolla.

target: Please do not add onions to my salad because I have an onion allergy.
Por favor, no ponga cebolla en mi ensalada porque tengo alergia a la cebolla.

prompts.capability: Ask about separate payment options
prompts.cue: Ask the server how your group can pay.
prompts.english: Can we pay separately, or does it have to be one payment?
prompts.spanish: ¿Podemos pagar por separado o tiene que ser un solo pago?

target: Can we pay separately, or does it have to be a single payment?
¿Podemos pagar por separado o debemos hacer un solo pago?

prompts.capability: Explain what has already been ordered before choosing more food
prompts.cue: Tell the server that your group has ordered appetizers but still needs to choose main dishes.
prompts.english: We already ordered the appetizers, but we still need to choose our main dishes.
prompts.spanish: Ya pedimos las entradas, pero todavía necesitamos elegir los platos fuertes.

target: We've already ordered the appetizers, but we still have to choose our main courses.
Ya pedimos las entradas, pero aún tenemos que elegir los platos fuertes.

prompts.capability: Report a cold dish and request a practical correction
prompts.cue: Tell the server about your soup and ask for help.
prompts.english: The soup arrived cold, so could you heat it up, please?
prompts.spanish: La sopa llegó fría, así que ¿podría calentarla, por favor?

target: The soup was cold when it arrived, so could you warm it up, please?
La sopa llegó fría, así que ¿la podría calentar, por favor?

prompts.capability: Contrast an ongoing past condition with a completed seating decision
prompts.cue: Describe what happened during your previous visit.
prompts.english: Last time, the terrace was full, so we sat inside.
prompts.spanish: La última vez, la terraza estaba llena, así que nos sentamos adentro.

target: Last time, the terrace was full, so we sat indoors.
La vez pasada, la terraza estaba llena, así que nos sentamos adentro.

prompts.capability: Connect a completed service mistake to a polite replacement request
prompts.cue: Explain that the dessert was incorrect and request a replacement.
prompts.english: You brought us the wrong dessert, so could you replace it for us, please?
prompts.spanish: Nos trajo el postre equivocado, así que ¿podría cambiárnoslo, por favor?

target: You brought us the wrong dessert, so could you change it for us, please?
Nos trajo el postre equivocado, así que ¿nos lo podría cambiar, por favor?

prompts.capability: Ask whether a table is available for a specific party size and time
prompts.cue: Ask the host about table availability.
prompts.english: Do you have a table for two at eight?
prompts.spanish: ¿Tiene una mesa para dos a las ocho?

target: Is there a table for two at eight?
¿Hay una mesa para dos a las ocho?

prompts.capability: Sequence two food orders politely
prompts.cue: Place an order in the desired sequence.
prompts.english: First, could we order the soup and then the tacos?
prompts.spanish: Primero, ¿podríamos pedir la sopa y después los tacos?

target: Could we order the soup first and the tacos afterward?
¿Podríamos pedir primero la sopa y después los tacos?

prompts.capability: Request a dish without an ingredient for a meal
prompts.cue: Order lunch with a simple omission.
prompts.english: For lunch, I want the chicken without sauce, please.
prompts.spanish: Para el almuerzo, quiero el pollo sin salsa, por favor.

target: At lunch, I want the chicken without sauce, please.
Para almorzar, quiero el pollo sin salsa, por favor.

prompts.capability: Politely request a missing item immediately
prompts.cue: Ask the server for the bread that has not arrived.
prompts.english: Could you bring us the bread now, please?
prompts.spanish: ¿Podría traernos el pan ahora, por favor?

target: Could you please bring us the bread now?
¿Nos podría traer el pan ahora, por favor?

prompts.capability: Explain that an ordered dish is no longer available
prompts.cue: Respond when the restaurant cannot provide part of your order.
prompts.english: We ordered the vegetarian dish, but it is no longer available.
prompts.spanish: Pedimos el plato vegetariano, pero ya no está disponible.

target: We ordered the vegetarian dish, but it's no longer available.
Pedimos el plato vegetariano, pero ya no se encuentra disponible.

prompts.capability: Ask about using two cards while contrasting a previous payment method
prompts.cue: Ask whether two cards can be used today.
prompts.english: Last time we paid cash, but today can we use two cards?
prompts.spanish: La última vez pagamos en efectivo, pero hoy ¿podemos usar dos tarjetas?

target: We paid cash last time, but can we use two cards today?
La vez pasada pagamos en efectivo, pero ¿podemos usar dos tarjetas hoy?

prompts.capability: Contrast a past restaurant habit with one completed event
prompts.cue: Describe a previous pattern of visits and a particular meal.
prompts.english: Last month, we came here every Friday, but one night we tried the daily set menu.
prompts.spanish: El mes pasado veníamos aquí todos los viernes, pero una noche probamos el menú del día.

target: We came here every Friday last month, but one night we tried the set menu.
El mes pasado veníamos aquí cada viernes, pero una noche probamos el menú del día.

prompts.capability: Connect an overcooked dish to a polite billing correction request
prompts.cue: Ask for a charge to be removed after a cooking problem.
prompts.english: Because the steak was overcooked, could you take it off the bill, please?
prompts.spanish: Como el bistec quedó demasiado cocido, ¿podría quitarlo de la cuenta, por favor?

target: Could you take the steak off the bill, please, since it was overcooked?
Ya que el bistec quedó demasiado cocido, ¿podría quitarlo de la cuenta, por favor?

prompts.capability: Mention a reservation and report that the table is still not ready
prompts.cue: You have arrived for your reservation, but your table is not ready.
prompts.english: We have a reservation, but our table is not ready yet.
prompts.spanish: Tenemos una reserva, pero nuestra mesa todavía no está lista.

target: We have a reservation, but our table still isn't ready.
Tenemos una reserva, pero nuestra mesa aún no está lista.

prompts.capability: Politely request a side substitution with an order
prompts.cue: Order fish and ask for rice instead of fries.
prompts.english: Could you bring me rice instead of fries with the fish, please?
prompts.spanish: ¿Podría traerme arroz en lugar de papas fritas con el pescado, por favor?

target: Could you bring me rice rather than fries with the fish, please?
¿Me podría traer arroz en vez de papas fritas con el pescado, por favor?

prompts.capability: Ask which dessert is safe for a guest with a nut allergy
prompts.cue: Your daughter has a nut allergy. Ask about dessert options.
prompts.english: My daughter has a nut allergy, so which dessert does not contain nuts?
prompts.spanish: Mi hija tiene alergia a las nueces, así que ¿qué postre no contiene nueces?

target: My daughter is allergic to nuts, so which dessert doesn't contain any?
Mi hija es alérgica a las nueces, así que ¿qué postre no tiene nueces?

prompts.capability: Request one bill when the group is paying together
prompts.cue: Your group will pay together. Ask for a single bill.
prompts.english: We are paying together, so could you bring us one bill, please?
prompts.spanish: Vamos a pagar juntos, así que ¿podría traernos una sola cuenta, por favor?

target: We're paying together, so could you bring us a single bill, please?
Vamos a pagar juntos, así que ¿nos podría traer una sola cuenta, por favor?

prompts.capability: Report that a drink ordered earlier has still not arrived
prompts.cue: You ordered coffee twenty minutes ago, and it has not arrived.
prompts.english: We ordered coffee twenty minutes ago, and it still has not arrived.
prompts.spanish: Pedimos café hace veinte minutos y todavía no ha llegado.

target: We ordered coffee twenty minutes ago, and it still hasn't arrived.
Hace veinte minutos pedimos café y todavía no ha llegado.

prompts.capability: Connect a missing drink to a polite request to remove it from the bill
prompts.cue: Your drink never arrived. Ask to have it removed from the bill.
prompts.english: They did not bring me the drink, so could you take it off the bill, please?
prompts.spanish: No me trajeron la bebida, así que ¿podría quitarla de la cuenta, por favor?

target: Since they didn't bring me the drink, could you remove it from the bill, please?
Como no me trajeron la bebida, ¿podría quitarla de la cuenta, por favor?

prompts.capability: Contrast an imminent past restaurant event with the service received
prompts.cue: Describe what happened when you visited in May just before the kitchen closed.
prompts.english: When we came here in May, they were about to close the kitchen, but they served us anyway.
prompts.spanish: Cuando vinimos aquí en mayo, estaban por cerrar la cocina, pero de todos modos nos atendieron.

target: When we came here in May, they were just about to close the kitchen, but they served us anyway.
Cuando vinimos aquí en mayo, estaban a punto de cerrar la cocina, pero de todos modos nos atendieron.

prompts.capability: Dispute an incorrect charge and request a corrected bill politely
prompts.cue: You were charged for a bottle you did not order. Ask for a corrected bill.
prompts.english: Since we were charged for a bottle we did not order, could you remove that charge and bring us the corrected bill, please?
prompts.spanish: Como nos cobraron por una botella que no pedimos, ¿podría quitar ese cargo y traernos la cuenta corregida, por favor?

target: Because we were billed for a bottle we did not order, could you remove that charge and bring us the corrected bill, please?
Como nos cobraron por una botella que no pedimos, ¿podría eliminar ese cargo y traernos la cuenta corregida, por favor?

prompts.capability: Ask how long the wait is for a table
prompts.cue: Ask the host about the wait time.
prompts.english: How long do we have to wait for a table?
prompts.spanish: ¿Cuánto tiempo tenemos que esperar para conseguir una mesa?

target: How long must we wait for a table?
¿Cuánto tenemos que esperar para conseguir una mesa?

prompts.capability: Politely ask what is included with a menu item
prompts.cue: Ask the server about a lunch dish.
prompts.english: For lunch, could you tell me what comes with the grilled fish, please?
prompts.spanish: Para el almuerzo, ¿podría decirme qué incluye el pescado a la parrilla, por favor?

target: For lunch, could you please tell me what is served with the grilled fish?
Para el almuerzo, ¿podría decirme con qué viene el pescado a la parrilla, por favor?

prompts.capability: Politely request sauce on the side
prompts.cue: Make a short request for sauce to be served separately.
prompts.english: The sauce on the side, please.
prompts.spanish: La salsa aparte, por favor.

target: Sauce on the side, please.
Salsa aparte, por favor.

prompts.capability: Report an overly salty dish and politely request a replacement
prompts.cue: Tell the server about the soup and ask for a solution.
prompts.english: The soup is too salty, so could you bring me another one, please?
prompts.spanish: La sopa está demasiado salada, así que ¿podría traerme otra, por favor?

target: The soup is too salty, so could you bring me a different one, please?
La sopa está demasiado salada, así que ¿me podría traer otra, por favor?

prompts.capability: Report that part of an earlier order is still missing
prompts.cue: Tell the server about a delayed order.
prompts.english: We ordered the sandwiches forty minutes ago, but one of them is still missing.
prompts.spanish: Pedimos los sándwiches hace cuarenta minutos, pero todavía falta uno.

target: We ordered sandwiches forty minutes ago, but one is still missing.
Hace cuarenta minutos pedimos los sándwiches, pero todavía falta uno.

prompts.capability: Recount a previous visit and a recommendation received
prompts.cue: Describe a previous lunch at the restaurant.
prompts.english: Last Sunday, we came for lunch, and the server recommended the daily special.
prompts.spanish: El domingo pasado vinimos a almorzar y el mesero nos recomendó el plato del día.

target: We came for lunch last Sunday, and the server recommended the daily special.
Vinimos a almorzar el domingo pasado y el mesero nos recomendó el plato del día.

prompts.capability: Connect a previous order, a recommendation, and a service problem
prompts.cue: Describe a problem from a previous visit.
prompts.english: On our previous visit, we ordered the paella because the server recommended it, but it arrived too salty.
prompts.spanish: En nuestra visita anterior, pedimos la paella porque el mesero la recomendó, pero llegó demasiado salada.

target: During our previous visit, we ordered the paella because the server recommended it, but it arrived too salty.
Durante nuestra visita anterior, pedimos la paella porque el mesero la recomendó, pero llegó demasiado salada.

prompts.capability: Report a duplicate charge and request a refund
prompts.cue: Explain a billing problem to the manager.
prompts.english: Yesterday, they charged me twice for the same meal, so I showed the manager both charges and requested a refund.
prompts.spanish: Ayer me cobraron dos veces por la misma comida, así que le mostré ambos cargos al gerente y pedí un reembolso.

target: Yesterday, I was charged twice for the same meal, so I showed the manager both charges and asked for a refund.
Ayer me cobraron dos veces por la misma comida; por eso le mostré ambos cargos al gerente y pedí un reembolso.

prompts.capability: Request a quieter table and give a reason politely
prompts.cue: Say this to the host.
prompts.english: Because this table is by the door, could you give us a quieter one, please?
prompts.spanish: Como esta mesa está junto a la puerta, ¿podría darnos una más tranquila, por favor?

target: Since this table is by the door, could you give us a quieter one, please?
Ya que esta mesa está junto a la puerta, ¿podría darnos una más tranquila, por favor?

prompts.capability: Politely request a dish without cheese for dinner
prompts.cue: Say this when ordering from the server.
prompts.english: For dinner, could you make the pasta without cheese, please?
prompts.spanish: Para la cena, ¿podría preparar la pasta sin queso, por favor?

target: For dinner, could you please prepare the pasta without cheese?
Para la cena, ¿podría hacer la pasta sin queso, por favor?

prompts.capability: Ask which soup is vegetarian for dinner
prompts.cue: Ask the server about the menu.
prompts.english: For dinner, which soup is vegetarian?
prompts.spanish: Para la cena, ¿qué sopa es vegetariana?

target: At dinner, which soup is vegetarian?
Para cenar, ¿qué sopa es vegetariana?

prompts.capability: Politely ask to divide the bill into three equal parts before paying
prompts.cue: Say this to the server.
prompts.english: Before paying, could you divide the bill into three equal parts, please?
prompts.spanish: Antes de pagar, ¿podría dividir la cuenta en tres partes iguales, por favor?

target: Could you divide the bill into three equal parts before paying, please?
¿Podría dividir la cuenta en tres partes iguales antes de pagar, por favor?

prompts.capability: Add an item after a completed order
prompts.cue: Say this to the server after placing your order.
prompts.english: We have already placed our order, but could we add a salad?
prompts.spanish: Ya hemos hecho el pedido, pero ¿podríamos agregar una ensalada?

target: We've already placed our order, but could we add a salad?
Ya hemos pedido, pero ¿podríamos agregar una ensalada?
communicative: Ya hicimos el pedido, pero ¿podríamos agregar una ensalada?

prompts.capability: Describe a completed visit and the restaurant atmosphere at that time
prompts.cue: Describe a previous visit to the restaurant.
prompts.english: Two weeks ago, we came for dinner, and the dining room was almost empty.
prompts.spanish: Hace dos semanas vinimos a cenar y el salón estaba casi vacío.

target: We came for dinner two weeks ago, and the dining room was almost empty.
Vinimos a cenar hace dos semanas y el salón estaba casi vacío.

prompts.capability: Explain that main dishes arrived too early and request a practical solution
prompts.cue: Say this to the server.
prompts.english: The server brought the main dishes while we were still eating the appetizers, so could you keep them warm, please?

target: The server brought out the main dishes while we were still eating the appetizers, so could you keep them warm, please?
El mesero trajo los platos fuertes mientras aún comíamos las entradas, así que ¿los podría mantener calientes, por favor?

prompts.capability: Dispute a separately charged tax and request a corrected total politely

target: The menu said that tax was included, but they charged it separately; could you please correct the total?
El menú decía que el impuesto estaba incluido, pero nos lo cobraron por separado; ¿podría corregir el total, por favor?

prompts.capability: Request clean utensils politely and explain an allergy concern

target: Could you use clean utensils since I have a seafood allergy?
¿Podría usar utensilios limpios ya que tengo alergia a los mariscos?

prompts.capability: Request a table location while specifying an unwanted condition

Necesitamos una mesa junto a la ventana, pero sin luz solar directa.

prompts.capability: Ask whether service is included and clarify whether a tip is needed

¿Podría decirme si el servicio está incluido o debemos dejar propina?

target: This juice is warmer than I expected, so could you bring me a colder one, please?
Este jugo está más tibio de lo que esperaba, así que ¿me podría traer uno más frío, por favor?

prompts.capability: Explain that a dish was prepared against a modification request and ask for a replacement

target: We ordered the pasta without cream, but it was prepared with cream; could you bring me another one, please?
Pedimos la pasta sin crema, pero la prepararon con crema; ¿me podría traer otra, por favor?

target: Last month, the dining room was noisy, so we ate on the patio; could we sit there again this time?
El mes pasado, el salón estaba ruidoso, así que comimos en el patio; esta vez, ¿podríamos sentarnos allí de nuevo?
